comparison.objective: Raise a folding reading stand and engage its stay in the steepest ratchet notch; the candidate sets a gripper opening stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Articulated linkage motion past a notch followed by controlled lowering into engagement, not driver/wrench counterholding.
comparison.success_condition: Stay foot must occupy the top notch, board near its target angle, released and clear; candidate requires a screw setting locked and cycle-tested.
comparison.reason: Both establish an angle and verify retention, but ratchet engagement tests a different mechanism and manipulation ability.
